excerpt.rendered: The Student Services Department is dedicated to supporting students with diverse learning needs, ensuring every child has the opportunity to succeed in school and make meaningful educational progress. Our goal is to provide services and supports that empower students to engage academically and develop into active, contributing members of the community.
